title: Exact tensor--Hom adjunction of a Grothendieck separator
statement: Fix a universe $U$ as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal C$ be Grothendieck abelian relative to $U$ [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], with $U$-small Hom sets, and let $P\in\mathcal C$ be a generator, meaning that $\operatorname{Hom}(P,-)$ is faithful. Set $R=\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal C}(P)^{\mathrm{op}}$, and let $G:\mathcal C\to\operatorname{Mod}_R$ send $c$ to $\operatorname{Hom}(P,c)$ with the left $R$-action by precomposition; $\operatorname{Mod}_R$ denotes left modules with underlying sets in $U$. There is a left adjoint $F$ to this $G$. Both functors are additive; $G$ is fully faithful; $F$ preserves finite limits; and the counit $FG\to\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal C}$ is an isomorphism.

This is the theorem used in HNR Remark A.4; no Stacks tag is asserted.
